summary: Add an actual-source quote policy lab covering lifecycle conflicts, integer-cent totals, exact discount thresholds and review routing.
Preserve production behavior and teach boundary analysis with real money helpers and error classes.
limits: Five Node cases execute actual quote policy, money helpers and error classes without dependency doubles. No quote service, Next, Prisma, transaction, tenant authorization or order conversion execution.
Pure policy tests use valid typed-like fixtures; request-schema validation, invalid runtime enum values and concurrent approval/price changes are outside this lab. No production code changed.
